manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
